title: Annotators with Attitudes: How Annotator Beliefs And Identities Bias Toxic Language Detection
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion. Its focus is on how annotator identities and beliefs (related to race, politics, and attitudes towards speech) bias toxic language detection.
